title: Oily Skin in Winter: Why It Feels Dry and the Routine That Helps
ex: Why oily skin can be shiny and flaky at once in winter, a simple morning and night routine, gel vs cream, and the mistakes to avoid.
rt: Oily Skin in Winter: Simple Morning & Night Care | Mirc Glow
rd: Oily skin in winter: why it can be shiny and flaky at once, a gentle morning and night routine, gel vs cream for cold weather, and mistakes to avoid.
quick: Oily skin in winter still needs moisture, because cold air and heaters dry the surface while the T-zone keeps making oil. Use a gentle, low-foam cleanser, add a light hydrating layer, switch from gel to a light cream at night and keep wearing sunscreen every morning.
facts: Oily skin can still be dehydrated, especially in winter.
Hot water and strong foaming cleansers add to winter dryness.
Move one step richer in winter, not straight to a heavy cream.
Winter sun still causes tanning, so sunscreen stays.
